templates.why_chosen: High-confidence matrix exemplar of four numbered Tenant/Host/NIC mini-stacks sharing one ownership-colour legend on the right, showing exactly which layer intercepts control verbs in each virtualization scheme.
templates.what_to_learn: Repeat the identical three-row stack across numbered variants and colour every box by a fixed ownership vocabulary so the eye compares roles, not shapes; the weakness here warns that without a visible border between variants, the layout can misread as one crowded panel instead of four.
